additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body: When you select an outlet for example DC1 on the display and you try to launch a charging session on DC2 by OCCP application, the charger received the OCPP start transaction without information on the screen, and when we tried to connect the outlet DC2 on the car the charge doesn't start. Same issue with the opposite logic on the outlet .
